title: Paper Planes, a searchable archive for a zine collective
summary: Twenty years of photocopied zines, scanned, tagged and made browsable. An editorial site with a very small build.

content.text: Paper Planes has made zines since 2006: photocopied, stapled, passed around. Most issues exist in one shoebox. This site is the shoebox, with a search box.
Volunteers scanned 212 issues. Each got a title, a date and tags. The site is static, so hosting costs almost nothing, and the archive can outlive its maintainers.
